label: 7360 ISAM FX-8 OLT
description: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX-8 access node/OLT, 8RU shelf with 8 line-termination (LT) slots and 2 NT controller slots on a 2x 100G/slot backplane; 128 GPON ports at 16 ports/slot. This spec models one 16-port GPON LT card in slot 1 (1/1/1-16) + the four configurable 10G/1G SFP+ network links on the FANT-F controller = 20 ports. No dedicated management port; management is in-band via 5520 AMS.
